title.narrative: Building Resilience through Life-Saving Multi-Sectoral (WASH, Nutrition, Child Protection) Lean Season Response for Vulnerable affected individual

description.narrative: ltpgtIn response to the ongoing humanitarian crisis in Monguno LGA, which is exacerbated by food insecurity, recent flooding, and large-scale displacement, SAHEI and LPF will implement a six-month multi-sectoral emergency response. This intervention targets 28,830 vulnerable individuals, including children under five and pregnant and breastfeeding women (PBWG), by providing integrated life-saving services during the critical lean season. The project aligns with the allocation strategy, aiming to address the urgent nutrition, WASH, and protection needs that increase significantly during this period.ltbrgtThe nutrition component will deliver both preventive and curative services to 2,980 vulnerable individual especially children and PBWG by carrying out some of the stated key activities that will include mass and family MUAC screenings, treatment of Severe and Moderate Acute Malnutrition (SAM/MAM) through OTPs and targeted supplementary feeding programs, micronutrient supplementation, and Maternal Infant and Young Child Nutrition (MIYCN) counseling. These services will be closely linked with hygiene promotion and cash/voucher assistance, ensuring a comprehensive approach that addresses both immediate and underlying causes of malnutrition.ltbrgtIn response to WASH needs, this project will deliver chlorinated water through trucking, rehabilitate both handpump and solar boreholes, and maintain gender-segregated sanitation facilities/points, desludging of latrines in flood-prone IDP camps. With the permission of the sector, hygiene kits, including menstrual hygiene materials for women and girls, will be distributed, alongside intensive hygiene promotion sessions to prevent waterborne diseases. These activities directly align with the NHF strategy's WASH priorities, with indicators tracking safe water access, improved sanitation, and cholera mitigation.lt/pgtltpgtTo strengthen the protective environment for children, the child protection component of the project will focus on case management for vulnerable and at-risk children, psychosocial support, and family tracing and reunification. Community-based reintegration services for children associated with armed groups will be scaled up, alongside awareness sessions on child rights and life skills training for adolescents and caregivers. Community-based care and family strengthening activities will not be left behind with reporting and responding to abuse, neglect, and exploitation related systems and issues.ltbrgtThe integration of protection, nutrition, and WASH ensures that the most at-risk individuals in Monguno, particularly children and women receive holistic, dignified, and timely support.ltbrgtlt/pgt
